The estimate uses your average spending on matching weekdays.
The model learns locally from weekdays, the day within your salary period, the days after salary, Ramadan and Eid, and previous spending.
The personal model must pass independent checks and beat the initial estimate; history alone does not activate it.

We compare this payment with the median of your earlier payments to the same merchant using the same payment source. This is a statistical observation; a larger payment is not necessarily incorrect and stays in your totals.
